title: Hangul IME Relay architecture and sync pattern
desc: HangulImeRelay WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook: arch + bugs. KEY: daemon-only hook (Eye must NOT call Install), Global\WkImeRelay mutex singleton.
steps:
Architecture: WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook intercepts keystrokes when Korean mode ON. Composes via ImeProxy (system IME window) or HangulComposer FSM fallback. Toggle: Right Alt (VK_RMENU) or VK_HANGUL (0x15). Bypass: passes through when foreground window has working system IME (e.g. non-ConPTY windows).
Files: HangulImeRelay.cs (_koreanMode flag + hook), .Composer.cs (syllable FSM), .ImeProxy.cs (proxy window), .Inject.cs (injection), ImeRelayDaemon.cs (lifecycle), AppBotEyeGlobalMode.cs (spawn).
BUG 2026-05-08: _koreanMode hardcoded true on install -- fixed to call IsSystemImeKoreanMode() instead.
BUG 2026-05-08: CreateImeProxy() forced ImmSetOpenStatus -- fixed to sync from system state.
IsSystemImeKoreanMode() reads ImmGetContext(GetForegroundWindow()) then ImmGetOpenStatus()+ImmGetConversionStatus(). IME_CMODE_NATIVE=1 means Hangul active.

BUG 2026-05-09: Path A (proxy) Backspace was flushing composition then passing BS to terminal. Fix: FeedKeyToProxy(VK_BACK) when composing.
BUG 2026-05-09: Path B (FSM) jamo feed loop redundant erase+re-inject. Fix: track _prevPreviewChar, skip when !HasCommit && Preview==_prevPreviewChar.

ARCH FIX 2026-05-09: Multi-daemon hook conflict -- toggle broken (commit 67531f0b).
ROOT CAUSE: Eye called HangulImeRelay.Install() at startup AND ImeRelayDaemon.Spawn() spawned separate daemon that also installed WH_KEYBOARD_LL. Daemon singleton detection used log file scan but launcher never created log files -> every Spawn() call saw no daemon -> 3+ competing hooks.
FIX 1: AppBotEyeGlobalMode.cs -- RelayWatchdog() no longer calls HangulImeRelay.Install(). Eye never installs hook. Daemon owns the hook exclusively.
FIX 2: ImeRelayDaemon.cs -- Named Mutex Global\WkImeRelay as primary singleton gate. Spawn() checks MutexHeld() first. Run() creates mutex initiallyOwned=true; exits immediately if live owner holds it. Log-file scan kept only for version comparison during binary update.
FUTURE: Store caller CWD as Window Property (SetProp) on Chrome window at launch -- current eye_ticks.jsonl PromptHwnd approach works but HWNDs go stale after session end.
BUG 2026-05-09: HasRealImeContext returned true for Windows Terminal causing relay bypass. Fix commit 139cf6fb: check UnicodeWindowClasses before ImmGetContext.
